column1: # The texts of Seasons whose Japanese is not the Japanese text of their representative (engine/language/language.h):
# the first identifier of their group whose US text lies where theirs does. Every other US text takes that text, when
# its commands are the US text's (language_same_commands: the \sym, which only draw a glyph, and the text's speed
# aside). The first row pins the Japanese ROM the table was measured on, by its SHA-1. A row then: the texts (TX_GGII,
# four hexadecimal digits each, or a range first-last, space-separated), the language (ja), the source of their text,
# and why. A source is one of:
#   jp:TX_GGII   the Japanese text of that identifier: the Japanese ROM has the text there
#   rule:NAME    the Japanese text of the representative, adapted to the US code by a rule (language_rules.c)
#   own:KEY      the port's own translation, unofficial (config/language_own_ja.tsv)
